PART 436—FEDERAL ENERGY MANAGEMENT AND PLANNING PROGRAMS Authority: 42 U.S.C. 7101 et seq.; 42 U.S.C. 8254 ; 42 U.S.C. 8258 ; 42 U.S.C. 8259b ; 42 U.S.C. 8287 , et seq. Source: 44 FR 60669 , Oct. 19, 1979, unless otherwise noted. § 436.1 Scope. This part sets forth the rules for Federal energy management and planning programs to reduce Federal energy consumption and to promote life cycle cost effective investments in building energy systems, building water systems and energy and water conservation measures for Federal buildings. [ 61 FR 32649 , June 25, 1996] § 436.2 General objectives. The objectives of Federal energy management and planning programs are: ( a ) To apply energy conservation measures to, and improve the design for construction of Federal buildings such that the energy consumption per gross square foot of Federal buildings in use during the fiscal year 1995 is at least 10 percent less than the energy consumption per gross square foot in 1985; ( b ) To promote the methodology and procedures for conducting life cycle cost analyses of proposed investments in building energy systems, building water systems and energy and water conservation measures; ( c ) To promote the use of energy savings performance
